feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Black travelers on Route 66 weren't welcome at most gas stations — except this one
entry.summary: Threatt Filling Station in Luther, Okla., was the first Black-owned gas station on Route 66. At a time when Black families needed the Green Book to find places to stay, eat, use the bathroom, it provided fuel and respite.

entry.title: Bleeding, birth defects: Congo residents sue over alleged mining pollution
entry.summary: A landmark lawsuit in Congo sees 27 residents accuse a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine of poisoning their community and the government of failing to protect them.

entry.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
entry.summary: High in the Colombian Andes, a growing number of volunteers are racing to save an unusual plant that helps supply water to millions — one tiny seedling at a time.

entry.title: Democrats probe whether Trump Jr.-aligned businesses benefit from government access
entry.summary: Investigators say companies with ties to Donald Trump Jr's investment firm, 1789 Capital, have profited since his father's reelection.

entry.title: They attended Trump's meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
entry.summary: Trump's meme coin dinners have sparked intense controversy. These two guests attended his latest on Sunday — and agreed to provide NPR inside access.

entry.title: Doctors struggle to save babies after parents refuse vitamin K
entry.summary: Doctors are fighting an uphill battle against disinformation about routine vitamin K shots given to newborns in the hospital. It helps prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder.

entry.title: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
entry.summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump is taking credit for the return of his close ally Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO, Nvidia's stock rose after Huang was reinstated, the Russia-Ukraine war is spilling into other countries.

entry.title: California Democrat Rep. Gomez resigns following ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations
entry.summary: California Congressman Rep. Jimmy Gomez says he will resign after a House Ethics report concluded Gomez's actions violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances."

entry.title: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
entry.summary: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.
